description: SAP BusinessObjects universe via a Semantic-Layer-SDK / IDT XML export (data foundation + business layer), NOT RWS JSON. Same eFashion model as universe_basic — exercises the ingestBobjSdkXml path: XML tables→elements, relational-binding SELECTs→columns/metrics, join+cardinality→relationship, predefined filter→warning, plus the name-aware View element. Guards that the XML and JSON ingests stay structurally identical. The .xml input (not .json) is passed to convert_bobj_to_sigma as a raw string and auto-detected.
